summary: Official Kazakhstan cadastral-map infrastructure and Karaganda-specific government cadastral documentation were found. The public viewer's published ArcGIS route returned HTTP 404 and the separate digital land-resources portal timed out, so no anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified and no GeoJSON sample was retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Kazakh/Russian discovery queries are recorded in city-1880-karaganda.json. They found the official AIS GZK map, gov.kz Public Cadastral Map documentation, Karaganda government cadastral-service notices, and a Karaganda land-cadastral plan document.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official AIS GZK map page retrieved. Page identifies the cadastral-map family and loads JavaScript configuration.
Viewer configuration retrieved. It publishes the ArcGIS route https://aisgzk.kz/arcgis/rest/services/aisgzkoz/MapServer for a map service; no unsafe fields were requested.
Published ArcGIS service route unavailable to this anonymous request; no schema, CRS, layer IDs, parcel IDs or geometry obtained.
Official digital land-resources portal did not respond within 20 seconds. No retry escalation, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass or credentials used.
Official government page describes the Public Cadastral Map as showing parcel boundaries, cadastral number, value and coordinates; it is documentation evidence, not a parcel API response.
Official Karaganda-region page describes obtaining state land-cadastre information through eGovMobile with authorization/signing; no restricted request attempted.
Official Karaganda land-cadastral-plan document found. It demonstrates parcel-document availability and cadastral identifiers, but is a single document and was not used as citywide geometry.

scopeLimits: The official viewer route was unavailable by anonymous direct request, so no parcel schema, CRS, stable native identity or geometry was confirmed.
The giprozem portal timeout and any map extent miss are not evidence of citywide absence.
Karaganda-specific cadastral documents demonstrate official records but do not establish a citywide open parcel API.
Authorization/signing and richer cadastral services were not accessed.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal or unsafe fields were requested, logged or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not admit a runtime adapter.
